headline: Oura to acquire AI primary-care startup Counsel Health for $625M
summary: Oura agreed to acquire Counsel Health, an AI-native primary care startup, for $625 million, after adding the company's AI chatbot to its app earlier this year. The deal comes weeks after Oura indefinitely postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO, citing uncertainty in the IPO market.
